acceptanceCriteria: A SIGINT or SIGTERM delivered to script/dogfood-finish.sh during either go build names the interrupted step and the NOT_PRODUCED block, matching DCW-V0-067 for finish-lane.
A focused test (or a script harness added for it) fails when the trap is removed.
body: Residual from PR #939 (V1-1397 obs 1, DCW-V0-067), 2026-10-15. finish-lane now names an interrupted step, but script/dogfood-finish.sh itself has no INT/TERM trap: a signal during its two go build steps exits silently with no step name. Reproduce: run script/dogfood-finish.sh and send SIGINT during the build phase; expected '<step> INTERRUPTED' plus the NOT_PRODUCED block, actual silent exit. No script test harness exists for it. SIGKILL silence is a documented non-goal.
title: script/dogfood-finish.sh exits silently on SIGINT/SIGTERM during its go build steps (DCW-V0-067 gap)
